protocol.geometry: N512, q16, 8193 samples, 559 tanh features plus bias
protocol.sustained_definition: First update below 1% at every subsequent executed update through 200000; not infinite-horizon convergence. confirmation_updates counts confirming states inclusively, including the first and final state.
protocol.schedule: Adam beta1=.9 beta2=.999; initial LR until20k, cosine decay to0.001 times initial LR at50k, constant thereafter.
protocol.numerical_status: FP64 diagnostics; Adam residual projections are not GD-theorem predictions.
protocol.positive_modes: Only retained positive SVD modes; omitted numerical directions excluded.
protocol.energy_normalization: All energies divided by original target squared norm; rho = eigenvalue / largest eigenvalue.
protocol.ratio_baseline: The gamma8 rank64 lower-bound evaluation is unresolved and omitted; its finite-spectrum reference remains shown.
protocol.connecting_lines: Lines between evaluated gamma values and saved Adam checkpoints are visual guides, not fitted dynamics.
